must_fix.title: Dialog loses focus return when content takes focus on mount (autoFocus / child effect)
must_fix.evidence: src/Dialog.tsx:58-66 saves document.activeElement in DialogBody's useEffect, after children's autoFocus/effects ran. Probe: trigger button opens <Dialog><button>first</button><input autoFocus/></Dialog>, click trigger, press Escape -> 'PROBE after close focused: <body>...' (without autoFocus it returns to <button>trigger</button>). Issue requires returning focus to whatever had it before opening; also overrides consumer autoFocus. No test covers it.

must_fix.title: Combobox never calls onChange(null); selection cannot be cleared
must_fix.evidence: Issue: 'value/onChange use the option value or null'. onChange is only called from choose() (src/Combobox.tsx:66-69). Probe: value='a', userEvent.clear(input), click elsewhere -> 'PROBE clear calls: [] input: Apple'. The null in onChange's type is unreachable.

nits: Focus trap is keydown-only; if focus reaches body (e.g. a click outside the dialog that isn't on the backdrop), Tab escapes and Escape stops working — consider a focusin guard or inert on the background.
Dialog's tabbable detection ignores positive tabindex ordering and CSS-hidden/closed <details> content.
Combobox overrides a consumer-supplied id because id={inputId} comes after the props spread.
The 'No results' role=status is mounted/unmounted with its text rather than kept as a persistent live region, so announcements are less reliable.
Test names use spec-ID prefixes ('C1:', 'T6:', 'hostile:') that don't map to anything in the repo.

report:
I found one confirmed bug and one gap against the issue, so this isn't ready to merge yet. `pnpm test` passes (81 tests in 4 files), `pnpm typecheck` passes, and `git diff HEAD --check` is clean. To probe edge cases I added a temporary test file at `tests/zz-probe.test.tsx`, ran it with `npx vitest run tests/zz-probe.test.tsx`, and deleted it. `git status --short` ends the same as it started. ## Must fix **1. Dialog doesn't return focus when a child grabs focus first (`src/Dialog.tsx:58-66`)** The dialog notes which element had focus inside a `useEffect` in `DialogBody`, after the dialog has already mounted. By then, anything inside the dialog that takes focus as it mounts has already done so. That includes an `autoFocus` input and a child's own effect that calls `.focus()`. The dialog then saves that inner element as the one to return to. When the dialog closes, that element is removed, the `isConnected` check fails, and focus falls to ``. The issue requires the dialog to return "focus to whatever had it before opening." - **Probe:** a trigger button that opens ``; click the trigger, then press `{Escape}`. - **Output:** ``` PROBE after open focused: PROBE after close focused:
``` - **Same probe without `autoFocus`:** focus returns to the trigger (`PROBE strict close: `). So the bug comes from saving focus too late, not from the restore logic. - **Second effect, visible in the same output:** the effect also overrides the consumer's `autoFocus` and moves focus to the first tabbable element. - **Fix:** save `document.activeElement` before the dialog body commits, for example in `Dialog` itself or in a ref set during render or in `useLayoutEffect` before the children mount. Add a test that covers this case. **2. Combobox can never call `onChange(null)`, so a selection can't be cleared (`src/Combobox.tsx:66-75`, `:133-137`)** The issue says "`value`/`onChange` use the option value or `null`." Here `onChange` is only called from `choose(index)`. If the user clears the input and leaves it, the old label comes back and `onChange` is not called. - **Probe:** `value="a"` with a working `setValue`; run `userEvent.clear(input)`, then click elsewhere. - **Output:** ``` PROBE clear calls: [] input: Apple ``` - **Result:** the `null` in `onChange: (value: string | null) => void` is dead in the type, and the README's "Called when the user selects an enabled option" only describes this behaviour; it doesn't justify it. - **Fix:** call `onChange(null)` when the committed text is empty. A clear action would also work, as long as it is tested and documented. ## Nits - The focus trap only reacts to Tab key presses. If focus reaches `` (for example, a click on a non-focusable spot when the backdrop doesn't cover the page), Tab leaves the dialog and Escape no longer works. Consider a `focusin` guard or `inert` on the page behind the dialog. - The Dialog's tabbable list ignores positive `tabindex` order and elements hidden by CSS (`display:none`, or inside a closed `
`). - Combobox puts its own `id` after the `...props` spread, so a consumer's `id` is silently dropped. - The "No results" `role="status"` element is mounted and unmounted along with its text. Screen readers announce a status region more reliably when it stays mounted and only its text changes. - Test names carry spec-style prefixes ("C1:", "T6:", "hostile:") that don't map to anything in the repo. ```json {"mergeable": false, "must_fix": [{"title": "Dialog loses focus return when content takes focus on mount (autoFocus / child effect)", "kind": "bug", "evidence": "src/Dialog.tsx:58-66 saves document.activeElement in DialogBody's useEffect, after children's autoFocus/effects ran.
